import sys

def solve():
    tokens = iter(sys.stdin.read().split())
    answers = []
    for _ in range(int(next(tokens))):
        words = [next(tokens) for _ in range(int(next(tokens)))]
        all_words = set(words)
        forward = [index for index, word in enumerate(words, 1) if word[0] == '0' and word[-1] == '1']
        backward = [index for index, word in enumerate(words, 1) if word[0] == '1' and word[-1] == '0']
        if not forward and not backward:
            answers.append('-1' if any(word[0] == '0' for word in words) and any(word[0] == '1' for word in words) else '0')
            continue
        if abs(len(forward) - len(backward)) <= 1:
            answers.append('0')
            continue
        selected = forward if len(forward) > len(backward) else backward
        needed = abs(len(forward) - len(backward)) // 2
        indices = [index for index in selected if words[index - 1][::-1] not in all_words][:needed]
        answers.append('-1' if len(indices) != needed else str(len(indices)) + '\n' + ' '.join(map(str, indices)))
    print('\n'.join(answers))

solve()
